name: Chest flags
source: Layout from the zeldaret/ss decompilation (TBoxflagManager: 32 flags per scene); scene indices as for scene flags. A chest's flag number is the low 6 bits of its rotation-Z parameter (the randomizer's TBox id minus 64).
format: Flag n of a scene is bit n%16 of the 16-bit word at base + 2*(2*scene + n/16).
